Package

hypernets hypernets-package
hypernets: Higher-Order Network Analysis

Reading results

One reader for every object.

hg_get()
Read a table from any hypernets object
hg_compare_communities() print(<hypernets_community_comparison>) hg_get(<hypernets_community_comparison>) plot(<hypernets_community_comparison>)
Compare community structure across representations
print(<hg_communities>) hg_get(<hg_communities>) plot(<hg_communities>)
Tables of a hypergraph community ensemble
hg_get(<net_hg>)
Tables of a hypergraph
hg_get(<net_hg_cluster>)

hg_get(<net_hg_measures>)
Tables of a hypergraph measures fit
hg_get(<net_hg_transduction>)
Tables of a hypergraph transduction fit
hg_get(<net_hon>)
Tables of a higher-order network
hg_get(<net_hon_boot>)
Inference table of a HON bootstrap
hg_get(<net_hon_communities>)
Tidy tables of a memory-network community result

Tables of a group model of memory networks
hg_get(<net_honem>)
Tables of a higher-order network embedding
hg_get(<hypernets_hypa>) hg_get(<net_hypa>)
Tables of a path-anomaly (HYPA) fit

Tables of a Markov order test

Tables of a grouped Markov order test
hg_get(<net_markov_stability>)
Tables of a Markov stability analysis
hg_get(<net_mogen>)
Tables of a multi-order generative model
hg_get(<net_path_dependence>)
Per-context table of a path-dependence analysis
hg_get(<net_temporal_hypergraph>)
Tidy tables of a temporal hypergraph
hg_get(<persistence_landscape>)
Table of a persistence landscape
hg_get(<persistent_homology>)
Tables of a persistent homology result
hg_get(<q_analysis>)
Tables of a q-analysis
hg_get(<simplicial_complex>)
Tables of a simplicial complex
hg_get(<text_hypergraph>)
Tidy tables of a text hypergraph

Simplicial complex from sequences, a network or a memory network

Memory networks

A node is a state plus the memory of how it was reached.

sequence-input
Sequence input shared by the sequence verbs
hon()
Higher-order network (HON) from sequences
honem()
Embedding of a higher-order network (HONEM)
mogen()
Multi-order generative model (MOGen) of sequences
hypa()
Hypergeometric anomalies of paths or of co-occurring node pairs
hypa(<default>) print(<hypernets_hypa>)
Path anomalies (HYPA) in sequences
hg_centrality()
Centralities of a hypergraph or a memory network
hg_centrality(<net_hon>)
Higher-order centralities with first-order projection
hg_communities()
Communities of a hypergraph or a memory network
hg_communities(<net_hon>)
Memory-network communities with the map equation
hg_bootstrap()
Bootstrap inference for higher-order network rules
hg_compare()
Permutation comparison of the rules of two groups
markov_order()
Test the Markov order of sequences
hg_markov_stability()
Markov stability of the states of a transition network
memory()
Per-context path dependence

Simplicial complexes

A set of mutually related nodes together with every subset.

Simplicial complex from sequences, a network or a memory network
hg_betti()
Betti numbers of a simplicial complex
hg_euler()
Euler characteristic of a simplicial complex
hg_degree()
Simplicial degree of every node
hg_qanalysis()
Q-analysis of a simplicial complex
hg_homology()
Persistent homology of a weighted network or a distance matrix
hg_landscape()
Persistence landscape of a persistence diagram
hg_bottleneck()
Bottleneck distance between persistence diagrams
hg_wasserstein()
Wasserstein Distance Between Persistence Diagrams

Hypergraphs

An arbitrary set of nodes bound as a unit.
